examples.approved_description:
Event: Corner kick.
In images 1-3, a red-and-white-striped player places the ball beside the
corner flag and corner arc. Images 4-10 show striped attackers and
white-shirted defenders gathering near goal. Images 11-12 show the delivery
reaching the crowded goal area. The goalkeeper in bright green appears to
collect the ball in images 13-15, after which the white team advances towards
midfield and the opposite penalty area in images 16-30.
Limits: The kick itself and individual contacts in the crowded box are not
clearly captured. Do not invent a successful header or goal.

Event: Free kick from the attacking flank.
Images 1-7 show a white-shirted player beside a stationary ball near the
touchline, away from the corner arc, with red defenders positioned around
their penalty area. Images 11-12 show a short ground pass towards another
white player outside the box. Images 13-14 show a subsequent delivery towards
the crowded goal area. By images 15-16, the ball travels away from goal and
defenders move outward. Further contested attacking play follows.
Limits: The original foul and exact defensive contact are not visible.
A defensive wall is not required for every free kick.

Event: Penalty kick resulting in a goal.
Images 1-8 show a blue-shirted taker preparing beside the ball; the wide view
shows the penalty setup, goalkeeper on the goal line, and other players
outside the penalty area. Images 9-10 show the run-up. Images 11-13 show the
goalkeeper diving and players entering the box. Images 14-30 show blue-team
celebrations, with the displayed score changing from 2-0 to 3-0, supporting
a scored penalty.
Limits: The preceding foul and precise foot-ball contact are not captured.
